Container.Name: domain-watchdog-worker
Container.Overview: Background worker for Domain Watchdog. Processes RDAP lookups, domain registration attempts, and async tasks from the queue. Must be deployed alongside the domain-watchdog container and share the same PostgreSQL, Redis, and Docker network settings.
Container.Requires: PostgreSQL container | Redis container | domain-watchdog (app) container | All must be on the same Docker network

Config.Name: App Secret
Config.Description: Must match the App Secret set in the domain-watchdog container.

Config.Name: Worker Consumer Name
Config.Description: Internal messenger consumer identifier. Leave as worker.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Container Name
Config.Description: Container name of your existing PostgreSQL instance. Must match domain-watchdog container setting.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Port
Config.Description: Port your PostgreSQL container listens on.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Database
Config.Description: Must match the database name set in the domain-watchdog container.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL User
Config.Description: Must match the PostgreSQL user set in the domain-watchdog container.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Password
Config.Description: Must match the PostgreSQL password set in the domain-watchdog container.

Config.Name: PostgreSQL Version
Config.Description: PostgreSQL server version. Match your existing container.

Config.Name: Redis Container Name
Config.Description: Container name of your existing Redis instance. Must match domain-watchdog container setting.

Config.Name: Redis Port
Config.Description: Port your Redis container listens on.
